citation: Bailer-Jones et al. 2018 find about 20 within 1 pc per Myr
note: Completeness-corrected rate of encounters within 1 pc: 19.7 ± 2.2 per Myr, expected to scale as the square of the encounter distance; Matched by the 19.7 per Myr figure, which is in the abstract. Quadratic scaling gives about 0.2 per Myr within 0.1 pc, consistent with "a few at most". The authors warn that spurious parallaxes may inflate the rate. Cite needs title, journal and DOI.
